zh.name: 机构登录与模型接入
zh.summary: 通过浏览器登录兼容的机构网关，发现模型并自动续期。支持 LiteLLM OAuth 与实验性 oidc-llm 接入。

en.name: Identity & model access
en.summary: Sign in to a compatible gateway through your browser, discover models and renew tokens. Supports LiteLLM OAuth and experimental oidc-llm integration.

zh.name: Knowledge Studio
zh.summary: 把资料变成报告、演示、思维导图、测验与闪卡；配套成果服务提供 Office 预览和媒体制作，与对话共用。

en.name: Knowledge Studio
en.summary: Turn materials into reports, presentations, mind maps, quizzes and flashcards, with companion artifact services for Office previews and media creation shared with conversations.

zh.name: 选段批注
zh.summary: 选中回复片段添加批注，保留来源编号，多条一起发送；复用 DSH 的输入框与草稿。

en.name: Response annotations
en.summary: Comment on selected passages, keep numbered references and send multiple annotations together using DSH’s composer and drafts.

zh.name: 文献检索
zh.summary: 检索 DBLP、arXiv 文献，获取 BibTeX 与可用全文，把研究资料接入后续任务。

en.name: Literature search
en.summary: Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX and available full text, and bring research sources into your next task.

zh.name: 本地记忆
zh.summary: 管理本地记忆、检索历史对话，让后续任务接得上已有背景。记忆在本机管理。

en.name: Local memory
en.summary: Manage local memory and search past conversations so new tasks can pick up existing context. Memories are managed on your machine.

zh.name: 邮件助手
zh.summary: 连接自己的邮箱，通过 IMAP 读取邮件，经授权通过 SMTP 发送，结合任务处理日常沟通。

en.name: Mail assistant
en.summary: Connect your mailbox, read mail over IMAP and send through SMTP with authorization, bringing communication into your workflow.

zh.name: 桌面宠物
zh.summary: 用可选形象展示任务与通知状态，在设置中开启。独立 npm 插件，需要 EduWork 桌面桥接。

en.name: Desktop pet
en.summary: Show task and notification status through a choice of companions. Enable it in settings; this npm plugin requires the EduWork desktop bridge.

zh.name: 远程访问
zh.summary: 配对后从其他终端的浏览器继续本机会话、处理授权。先部署中继并配置地址与接入 Key，再开启连接。

en.name: Remote access
en.summary: Pair another device to continue local sessions and handle approvals in its browser. Deploy a relay and configure its address and access key before enabling connections.
